observations.text: When SUL-25 is activated, it changes YAV-36 into an active carrier.
An active YAV-36 causes PEX-47 to be emitted.
Whenever PEX-47 reaches DOM-58, that DOM-58 adopts the terminal marker GIR-69.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of PEX-47 through DOM-58 is GIR-69; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims DOM-58 instead carries terminal marker BAD-86.
When SUL-42 is activated, it changes YAV-53 into an active carrier.
An active YAV-53 causes PEX-64 to be emitted.
Whenever PEX-64 reaches DOM-75, that DOM-75 adopts the terminal marker GIR-86.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of PEX-64 through DOM-75 is GIR-86; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims DOM-75 instead carries terminal marker BAD-13.
When SUL-59 is activated, it changes YAV-70 into an active carrier.
An active YAV-70 causes PEX-81 to be emitted.
Whenever PEX-81 reaches DOM-92, that DOM-92 adopts the terminal marker GIR-14.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of PEX-81 through DOM-92 is GIR-14; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims DOM-92 instead carries terminal marker BAD-31.
